criteria.id: a project can register a local Git repository
creating a WorkItem branch stores name, base, linked WorkItem, owner, and protection status
sync and rebase-check record unpushed, diverged, and conflict signals
a changeset commit uses a message template that includes the WorkItem id
patch, commit, push, pull request, and merge remain separate actions
push, pull request, and merge still require human approval
Code View shows repositories, branches, commits, diffs, changed files, and pull requests
unlinked branches appear in the project unlinked-code list
developer progress inspector shows Code View and customers cannot create branches
